messages:
ada: quick flag  restores for tenant-45 are failing with DecryptError — object metadata shows no SSE header.
raj: :grimacing: When were those snapshots uploaded?
ada: last night during the midnight batch, around 23:40 UTC. Only 4 objects affected.
soph: Any recent RBAC or presign changes?
ada: We toggled the presign feature-flag and rolled a tiny presign policy change to address part size calc. I suspect the presign dropped required SSE conditions for multipart finalize.
raj: Can we short-circuit: disable presign issuance and add a bucket policy to deny non-SSE PutObject on /snapshots/* ?
soph: Yes for mitigation. For remediation rewrap, we need a principal with kms:Encrypt and must preserve encryption context. Prefer ephemeral KMS grants over editing CMK policies.
ada: Agreed. I'll run a detection to list objects under /snapshots/ without SSE and narrow to that 23:30-00:30 window. If count small, rewrap copy under uploader principal after ephemeral grant creation.
encops-bot: Incident created: ENC-2026-501. Suggested actions: disable presign, detection scan, ephemeral grant + rewrap.
raj: Post-mortem items: add presign unit tests for SSE conditions, CI diffs for presign logic, and a reconciliation job for role->key mappings on role rename.
soph: Also add SIEM rule: alert on PutObject to /snapshots/* where object metadata missing x-amz-server-side-encryption.
ada: I'll patch the presign generator and push a hotfix to upload-proxy to validate conditions before issuing presigns. Will coordinate ephemeral grant creation with infra.
raj: Keep compliance in the loop if any regulated tenant is affected. Update the incident ticket with the detection output.
soph: Thanks. Keep updates short here.
